scenario_data.body: Many days have passed since Sayaka and I became a couple.
I enter the living room to find Sayaka at the desk.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Yeah. I had some free time so I thought I'd revisit care for the elderly."
Sayaka is merrily pouring over a textbook.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Now that Dad is better and I quit my job... it's time to focus on school."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "But why are you studying care for the elderly?"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "If you tell me your dreams... I can help you reach them."

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "You are my boyfriend after all, William."
My face burns when she suddenly faces me.
Sayaka zooms in on my face.
Sayaka nudges herself even closer to me.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "We already got Dad's blessing to marry."
Sayaka's Dad still thinks we're engaged.
Aoi stands in the living room doorway. Her eyes are like saucers.

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Woaaaah! What a scoop! Hey, girls, check it out!"
I try to stop her, but it's too late. Everyone's popped into the living room.

scenario_data.speaker: Misaki
scenario_data.body: "What's wrong, Aoi? What's the big scoop?"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "No, no! It's a joke! Right, Sayaka!?"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "I really want a fancy wedding dress."

scenario_data.speaker: Misaki
scenario_data.body: "Ohhh, what a surprise. I'd never think you'd get married."
Next to her, Mitsuka seems stunned.

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "Sayaka's wedding, eh... I wouldn't mind holding the veil for her."

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Then I'll be the maid of catering!"
Talk of my imaginary wedding with Sayaka gains more and more steam.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (I'm n-not sure whether to be flattered or embarrassed!)
There's one girl who's not cheering with the rest.
Ren looks at me, thinks for a second, then murmurs.

scenario_data.speaker: Ren
scenario_data.body: "Just kidding. I know you're not. Just one of Sayaka's trademark jokes."

scenario_data.speaker: Ren
scenario_data.body: "You took care of Sayaka... just like you'd promised."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "You gave my back a push... when Sayaka was in trouble..."
Ren's eyes grow wide in surprise.

scenario_data.speaker: Ren
scenario_data.body: "I just... enjoy watching Sayaka tease you."
Ren's face reddens a little when she says this.

scenario_data.speaker: Ren
scenario_data.body: "Just because I noticed you... doesn't mean you'd notice me."
Suddenly, Sayaka's face pops in front of mine.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Where should we go on our honeymoon!?"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "H-how far are we taking this joke!?"
I had a great day, in spite of the relentless teasing from my roommates.
At night, Sayaka comes to my room to hang out.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "If we get married... that means we can do lots of fun things, right?"
Sayaka smiles devilishly and puts her lips to my ear.
Sayaka had pushed herself on top of me.
One look at Sayaka's glittering eyes and I understand.
A sweet, melting sensation flows between us.
That sweet, first kiss of mine...
...was the sign of our true happiness together.

_source: OCR of YouTube upload Sayaka_E01 (DevilGh0stz), part 1. Text is machine-read: expect small typos. Player name normalised to William. Field nesting is a guess.
